title: Exact equivariant transport preserves strict off-diagonal presentations
statement: Let $C,D$ be abelian categories, $F,G$ additive autoequivalences, and assume ordinary derived categories exist for the underlying and fixed-pair categories [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Let $L:C\to D$ be additive exact, with $e:L\circ G\simeq F\circ L$ in Lean composition order. Write $J=D(\operatorname{mapOfNatIso}(e))$ and $H=D(L)$. For any $M,N\in D(C^F)$, $u\in V^{-1}_{M,N}$, and $f:M\to N$, a strict off-diagonal presentation of $(u,f)$ [lem-sf-cyclic-derived-off-diagonal-presentation] induces a strict off-diagonal presentation of $(\operatorname{tr}^{-1}(u),J(f))$ in $D(D^G)$, where transport is exactly that of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data] with cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison and the canonical shift maps. No boundedness, Grothendieck, or injectivity hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Unpack a presentation as a short exact complex sequence A to E to B, an underlying splitting s, an off-diagonal map u0, endpoint isomorphisms a:M to QB and c:QA[1] to N, and its two prescribed equalities. Apply mapOfNatIso e termwise. It is exact because L is exact and the forgetful functor creates finite limits and colimits. Thus the mapped sequence is short exact.

Naturality of e at s and u0 rewrites this as G(L(s)) theta_LE=theta_LB L(s)+G(L(u0)) theta_LA L(j), exactly the target presentation equation.

proof.text: The new endpoint a is J(a) followed by the localization factor J(QB) to Q(Jc B). The new c is the 1-shift of the inverse factor at A followed by the inverse shift comparison and J(c). Expand cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalClass and cyclicDerivedHomTransport. The exact composition factor identities identify alpha at QA and QB. Naturality identifies the endpoint maps. Shift coherence identifies the cancellation of shifts 1 and -1 on both sides. Cancel the adjacent factors to obtain the required underlying class equality. The private exactComparison_factors lemma obtains the forgetting-square factor equation directly from mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac. exactComparison_core applies that equation at both endpoints and uses naturality of L.mapDerivedCategoryFactors on u0. exactComparison_shift applies the shift compatibility of the comparison and map_shiftFunctorCompIsoId_inv_app. cancellation_natural moves the inverse localization factor through the shift cancellation. exactTransport_class combines these equalities, and exactTransport_endpoints applies naturality at a and c. Every helper is proved in the item module; none introduces an additional assumption.

theorem cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalPresentation_mapExact
    {M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)} {u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N (-1)}
    {f : M ⟶ N} (hp : CyclicDerivedOffDiagonalPresentation F u f) :
    CyclicDerivedOffDiagonalPresentation G
      (cyclicDerivedHomTransport F G (mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory
        L.mapDerivedCategory (fun r ↦ L.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso r)
        (cyclicDerivedExactForgetComparison F G L e) M N (-1) u)
      ((mapOfNatIso e).mapDerivedCategory.map f)
